name: sp-tools
description: Claude Code plugins by Stas Potapov: Android device control, HTML slide decks, moving commits between repositories and more. Each plugin is pinned to a release tag.

plugins.name: adbm
plugins.description: Android Debug Bridge Matrix: an agent drives Android devices and emulators instead of raw adb with deterministic commands, not guesses from screenshots — screen as text, taps that check the next screen, input, apps, logs, screenshots — plus visual checks: emulators by API level, Maestro flows in parallel, before/after board and contact sheet.

plugins.name: present
plugins.description: A Claude Code skill that walks you from an idea to a bespoke offline HTML slide deck: slide text, design brief, build with a presenter window and live notes, spoken run-through and trimming to time. Plus a short path: one page in one go.

plugins.name: git-xfer
plugins.description: Move commits between two unrelated git repositories: the git-xfer CLI on the agent's PATH and a skill that drives it — dedup, conflict dry run, honest abort.
